FIELD INCIDENT REPORT
Form FIR-1 (rev. 2026-03)
OPERATOR
Okanagan Crossing Pipelines Ltd.
REPORTED BY
Field operator
RECEIVED VIA
Phone call (on-call write-up)
DESCRIPTION OF THE EVENT (what happened, when, where, who, what was released)
Called in at about 2 PM today near Edson, AB. We were doing routine maintenance on the line
when we noticed some external coating disbondments and what looked like material
loss-corrosion and cracking on the pipe body. Then we smelled gas.
Checked the meters and saw a release-sweet natural gas, metered at exactly 192,183 m³.
Looks like the leak is either through the pipe body or a weld, not sure which yet. Still on site
trying to pin it down. Will update when we know more.
-Jess, field op
SUPERVISOR REVIEW
